description: Gets detailed content for documentation by ID returned from the `search` tool.

id.description: Canonical IDs use project/section/slug. Legacy project/slug, recipe:project/slug and ref:project/slug IDs are also accepted. For a link `/<section>/<slug>` the search tool did not return, use `<project>/<section>/<slug>`, with `<project>` taken from an ID this project already returned.

name: fetch
title: Fetch Documentation Page
